name: dumbbell standing scapular external rotation
description: Light dumbbell rotation that strengthens the small muscles behind the shoulder and between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your upper arm still and your shoulder blade pulled back and down.
Rotate your forearm outward as far as you comfortably can.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
